name: thyroid hormone receptor interactor 13

function.text: TRIP13 encodes pachytene checkpoint protein 2 homolog. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity and ATP hydrolysis activity. It participates in transcription by RNA polymerase II and oogenesis.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to oocyte maturation defect 9 (autosomal recessive). Postzygotic mosaic associations are recorded separately.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

mosaic_associations.mechanism: Postzygotic/mosaic disease context; constitutional versus mosaic applicability requires allele-specific review.
